description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is open in eQUEST. You need to model a targeted envelope retrofit by applying high-performance vacuum insulation panels to the East-facing facade ONLY.

1. Create a new Material named 'VacuPanel-R20' with Type = Resistance and Resistance = 20.0.
2. Create a new Construction named 'East-Retrofit-Wall' that uses the 'VacuPanel-R20' material as its layer.
3. Assign this new 'East-Retrofit-Wall' construction to ALL East-facing exterior walls (walls with 'E' in their name prefix, e.g., G.E*, M.E*, T.E*) on all floors.
4. Ensure that North, South, and West walls remain unchanged (retain their original construction).
5. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation.
6. Save the project.

Note: You must define the Material and Construction from scratch in the Building Shell module.
